chapterInfo.content:
13
Ɔdɔ ho asɛm
1Sɛ mede nnipa ne abɔfoɔ tɛkyerɛma mekasa, na menni dɔ a, na mete sɛ yaawa a ɛregyegyeɛ anaa akasaa a ɛrewosoɔ. 2#Mat 7.22; 17.20 Na sɛ mewɔ adiyie asɛnka, na menim ahuntasɛm nyinaa, ne nimdeɛ nyinaa, na mewɔ gyidie nyinaa ma metutu mmepɔ mpo, na menni dɔ a, mensɛ hwee. 3#Mat 6.2 Na sɛ mepore m’ahodeɛ nyinaa mema ahiafoɔ, na mede me nipadua mema sɛ wɔnhye,#13.3 Tete atwerɛ binom ka sɛ: Na mahoahoa me ho. na menni dɔ a, merennya ho mfasoɔ biara.
4Ɔdɔ wɔ abodwokyɛre, ne yam yɛ; ɔdɔ nyɛ ahoɔyea; ɔdɔ nyɛ ahokyerɛ, ɛmmema ne ho so, 5#Flp 2.4; 2.21 ɛnyɛ ne ho deɛ ɛmfata, ɛnhwehwɛ deɛ ɛyɛ ɔno nko ara ne deɛ, ne bo nha no, ɛmfa bɔne nhyɛ ne yam, 6#Rom 12.9 n’ani nnye deɛ ɛntene ho, na mmom ɛdi ahurisie wɔ nokorɛ mu. 7#Mmb 10.12; Rom 15.1 Ɛtie ade nyinaa, ɛgye ade nyinaa di, ɛnya ade nyinaa mu anidasoɔ, ɛtɔ ne bo ase ade nyinaa mu.
8Ɔdɔ to ntwa da. Nkɔmhyɛ deɛ, wɔbɛgu; kasa ahodoɔ deɛ, ɛbɛgyae; nimdeɛ deɛ, ɛbɛsa. 9Na yɛhunu adeɛ fa-ne-fa, na yɛhyɛ nkɔm fanefa. 10Na sɛ deɛ ɛwie pɛyɛ no nya ba a, ɛno na wɔbɛgu deɛ ɛyɛ fa-ne-fa no. 11Meyɛ abɔfra no, mekasaa sɛ abɔfra, medwenee sɛ abɔfra, metee asɛm ase sɛ abɔfra; na mebɛyɛɛ panin yi, magyae mmɔfraasɛm no. 12#2 Ko 5.7 Na seesei deɛ, yɛnam ahwehwɛ mu hunu adeɛ wɔ bɛ mu, na daakye deɛ, anim ne anim; seesei deɛ, mehunu adeɛ fa-ne-fa, na daakye deɛ, mɛhunu adeɛ mua sɛdeɛ wɔahunu me nso yi. 13#1 Te 1.3; 1 Yoh 4.16 Na afei gyidie, anidasoɔ, ɔdɔ, adeɛ mmiɛnsa yi na ɛtena hɔ; na ɔdɔ ne emu kɛseɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Sɛ mede nnipa ne abɔfoɔ tɛkyerɛma mekasa, na menni dɔ a, na mete sɛ yaawa a ɛregyegyeɛ anaa akasaa a ɛrewosoɔ. Na sɛ mewɔ adiyie asɛnka, na menim ahuntasɛm nyinaa, ne nimdeɛ nyinaa, na mewɔ gyidie nyinaa ma metutu mmepɔ mpo, na menni dɔ a, mensɛ hwee. Na sɛ mepore m’ahodeɛ nyinaa mema ahiafoɔ, na mede me nipadua mema sɛ wɔnhye, na menni dɔ a, merennya ho mfasoɔ biara.
Ɔdɔ wɔ abodwokyɛre, ne yam yɛ; ɔdɔ nyɛ ahoɔyea; ɔdɔ nyɛ ahokyerɛ, ɛmmema ne ho so, ɛnyɛ ne ho deɛ ɛmfata, ɛnhwehwɛ deɛ ɛyɛ ɔno nko ara ne deɛ, ne bo nha no, ɛmfa bɔne nhyɛ ne yam, n’ani nnye deɛ ɛntene ho, na mmom ɛdi ahurisie wɔ nokorɛ mu. Ɛtie ade nyinaa, ɛgye ade nyinaa di, ɛnya ade nyinaa mu anidasoɔ, ɛtɔ ne bo ase ade nyinaa mu.
Ɔdɔ to ntwa da. Nkɔmhyɛ deɛ, wɔbɛgu; kasa ahodoɔ deɛ, ɛbɛgyae; nimdeɛ deɛ, ɛbɛsa. Na yɛhunu adeɛ fa-ne-fa, na yɛhyɛ nkɔm fanefa. Na sɛ deɛ ɛwie pɛyɛ no nya ba a, ɛno na wɔbɛgu deɛ ɛyɛ fa-ne-fa no. Meyɛ abɔfra no, mekasaa sɛ abɔfra, medwenee sɛ abɔfra, metee asɛm ase sɛ abɔfra; na mebɛyɛɛ panin yi, magyae mmɔfraasɛm no. Na seesei deɛ, yɛnam ahwehwɛ mu hunu adeɛ wɔ bɛ mu, na daakye deɛ, anim ne anim; seesei deɛ, mehunu adeɛ fa-ne-fa, na daakye deɛ, mɛhunu adeɛ mua sɛdeɛ wɔahunu me nso yi. Na afei gyidie, anidasoɔ, ɔdɔ, adeɛ mmiɛnsa yi na ɛtena hɔ; na ɔdɔ ne emu kɛseɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
